headline: Israeli strikes kill five Hamas in Gaza amid Iran air defense alert
subheadline: Iranian air defenses activated in Isfahan city per semi-official Mehr news agency during Israeli strikes in Gaza killing five Hamas operatives including October 7 participants.
lede: Israeli strikes in Gaza killed five Hamas operatives, including two in Jabalia and three in Rafah, while the IDF cited systematic ceasefire violations. Iraqi Prime Minister ordered army into Jurf al-Sakhar against Iran-backed Kataib Hezbollah over oil smuggling, and Iranian air defenses activated in Isfahan. The IDF also demolished a West Bank home for rocket production and conducted a rare strike in Lebanon's Beqaa Valley.

sections.title: Russia Energy Strikes Escalate Across Ukraine
sections.body: Russia conducted a massive overnight barrage across Ukraine using Shahed-type drones, reactive drones, Geran-5 missiles, and Banderoil cruise missiles targeting energy infrastructure in Kyiv, Chernivtsi, and Poltava regions including the Kremenchuk oil refinery. Geran-5 missiles hit a substation near Kyiv, a substation in Kitsman in Chernivtsi, and the Kremenchuk oil refinery, while Banderoil missiles struck Poltava and Kremenchuk. Ukraine retaliated with a strike on Russia's Akhtubinsk airfield in the Astrakhan region causing over 30 explosions. Commercial vessels were hit by drones near Romanian Black Sea waters, with no casualties and fires extinguished.

sections.title: Israeli Strikes and Iranian Defense Alerts Rise
sections.body: Israeli strikes in Gaza killed five Hamas operatives including October 7 participants, while Iraqi forces moved against Iran-backed Kataib Hezbollah in Jurf al-Sakhar. The IDF demolished a West Bank home for rocket production and conducted a rare strike in Lebanon's Beqaa Valley. Iranian air defenses activated in Isfahan, and Bahrain warned of Iranian-backed Houthi threats amid rising regional tensions.

sections.title: Intelligence Assessment
sections.body: The simultaneous use of multiple strike systems against Ukrainian energy infrastructure indicates sophisticated coordination, while Iran's air defense activation and Israeli strikes on Hamas senior operatives suggest preparing for possible Israeli or US strikes. Iraq's move against Kataib Hezbollah and Bahrain's Houthi warning signal intra-Shia friction and proxy threat escalation.
